values.note: Daily: basic (water, electric, Wi-Fi) $38, full hookup (adds sewer and a cement patio) $40. Seasonal sites $475 (30-amp) or $500 (50-amp) a month plus metered electric, 6-month stay. Dump fee $20; $40 cancellation fee, no refunds for early departure.

note: RV-only park (no tents), pet friendly, on 40 acres with wooded trails and a pond at 1453 Townline Rd, Tawas City, just off US-23; pitched at adults and seniors, with potlucks and a 4th of July parade. Minutes from the Lake Huron shore (not on-water). Seasonal sites (6-month stay) are sold alongside nightly ones. --Claude
